description: Trigger a Dagster job when a specific Coalesce run (by runCounter) completes.

run_counter.label: Run Counter
run_counter.description: The Coalesce run to poll, by its runCounter (returned when the run was started, e.g. by CoalesceResource.start_run() or Coalesce's own UI/scheduler). Coalesce's Scheduler API has no way to list or search runs, so there is no 'latest run for a job' option -- the exact runCounter must already be known.

api_token_env_var.label: Api Token Env Var
api_token_env_var.description: Env var containing the Coalesce API token. Required unless resource_key is set.

api_base_url.label: Api Base Url
api_base_url.description: Coalesce API base URL. Ignored when resource_key is set.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Dagster job to trigger when the Coalesce run completes

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional resource key registered by a CoalesceResourceComponent. When set, polls run via that resource's own get_run_status(...) method instead of the inline api_token_env_var/api_base_url above.

name: Coalesce Job Sensor
